articles.title: Career Burnout: Time for a Change?
articles.excerpt: Burnout feels like a signal to leave. But your Twin knows it's more complicated. Sometimes you need a change of pace, sometimes a new role, sometimes it's time to quit. Learn to distinguish what your burnout is actually telling you.

articles.title: Career Goals: Setting Decisions That Stick
articles.excerpt: Most career goals fail because they're not decisions. Learn your Twin's framework for setting goals that actually stick—by making them personal, specific, and tied to values instead of just ambition.

articles.title: Company Culture Fit: Red Flags and Green Lights
articles.excerpt: Company culture determines whether you'll thrive or slowly burn out. Your Twin helps you read the signs of healthy culture before you accept an offer—and know when it's time to leave.

articles.title: Staying Updated: Continuous Learning Decisions
articles.excerpt: Your industry evolves constantly. The question isn't whether to learn—it's how to keep growing without burning out. Your Twin helps you build learning that sustains your career.

articles.title: Decision-Making in Career Transitions: Your Twin's Framework
articles.excerpt: Career transitions are pivotal moments. Learn how Twin intelligence can guide your most important career decisions—from evaluating opportunities to navigating uncertainty. Discover a framework that turns career crossroads into confident choices.

articles.title: Further Education: MBA or Bootcamp Decision
articles.excerpt: Considering further education? Your Twin helps you evaluate whether an MBA, bootcamp, or certification is worth the time and money—and which one actually moves your career forward.

articles.title: Entrepreneurship vs Employment: The Decision
articles.excerpt: The choice between starting your own business and staying employed isn't about ambition—it's about tradeoffs. Your Twin breaks down the real differences so you can decide based on what you actually want, not just what sounds cooler.

articles.title: How to Evaluate Job Offers Like Your Twin Would
articles.excerpt: Job offer in hand—now what? Learn a framework to evaluate job offers beyond salary. Discover how to weigh culture fit, growth, stability, and fulfillment to make a decision you won't regret.

articles.title: Freelancing Decision: Freedom vs Security
articles.excerpt: Freelancing promises freedom but demands uncertainty. Your Twin helps you evaluate whether you're ready for the tradeoffs—and whether freelancing is actually your best career move right now.

articles.title: Geographic Move for Career: Twin Perspective
articles.excerpt: Relocating for a job isn't just a career decision—it's a life decision. Your Twin helps you weigh opportunity against roots, cost of living against salary, career growth against personal stability.

articles.title: Industry Switch: Is Your Twin Guiding You Right?
articles.excerpt: Changing industries feels like starting over. Your Twin helps you evaluate whether the switch is a genuine opportunity or just escape—and how to make the transition without losing what you've built.

articles.title: Interview Preparation: Decision-Making Framework
articles.excerpt: Most interview prep focuses on answering questions. Your Twin knows the real skill is asking the right questions—and evaluating whether this company is actually right for you. Learn the framework that turns interviews into two-way decisions.

articles.title: Staying vs Leaving a Job You Love
articles.excerpt: Sometimes the hardest career decision isn't about jobs you hate—it's about staying at a job you love when growth has plateaued. Your Twin helps you know whether loyalty serves you or holds you back.

articles.title: Leadership Role Decision: Are You Ready?
articles.excerpt: Stepping into leadership is terrifying. Your Twin helps you evaluate whether you're ready for the role—and what you'll lose and gain in the transition.

articles.title: Mentorship Decisions: Who Should Guide Your Career?
articles.excerpt: The right mentor can accelerate your career by years. The wrong one can send you in circles. Your Twin helps you decide who deserves your trust and how to make mentorship actually work.

articles.title: Networking Decisions: Building Your Career
articles.excerpt: Networking feels like forced socializing, but your Twin knows it's actually about making intentional decisions about relationships. Learn to build a network that feels authentic and supports your career without the exhaustion.

articles.title: Should You Take That Promotion? Twin Insights
articles.excerpt: Not all promotions are good decisions. Your Twin knows how to evaluate whether a promotion aligns with your actual career, not just your ambition. Learn to say no to the wrong promotions.

articles.title: Remote vs Office: Making the Work Location Decision
articles.excerpt: The pandemic normalized remote work—but that doesn't mean it's right for everyone. Your Twin helps you decide based on your actual preferences, not just what's trendy or convenient.

articles.title: Resume Tips for Career Changers: Show Your Twin They Matter
articles.excerpt: Career changers face a unique resume challenge: how to show you're serious about a new direction without erasing your past experience. Learn how to craft a resume that tells the story of your intentional transition.

articles.title: Negotiating Your Salary: A Twin's Approach
articles.excerpt: Salary negotiation terrifies most people—but your Twin knows it's just another decision. Learn the framework that separates emotion from clarity, so you negotiate from strength instead of fear.

articles.title: Making Peace With Body Image Pressure
articles.excerpt: You can't out-argue body image pressure with logic alone. Your Twin helps you build a different relationship with it, piece by piece.

articles.title: Recovering From Burnout, Not Just Surviving It
articles.excerpt: Pushing through burnout and recovering from it are different projects. Your Twin helps you tell which one you're actually doing.

articles.title: Managing Caregiver Burnout
articles.excerpt: Caregiver burnout is one of the hardest to admit to, because someone else's needs feel more urgent than your own. Your Twin helps you hold both.

articles.title: Managing Stress That Won't Go Away
articles.excerpt: Chronic stress doesn't respond to the same tricks as a bad day. Your Twin helps you find what actually moves it.

articles.title: Choosing a Diet That Actually Fits Your Life
articles.excerpt: The best diet isn't the one with the best results in a study. It's the one you can still be doing in a year. Your Twin helps you pick that one.

articles.title: Starting a Fitness Journey: Your Twin's Framework
articles.excerpt: Starting to exercise feels overwhelming. Your Twin helps you build a fitness journey that actually sticks—by starting small and focusing on consistency over intensity.

articles.title: Gym vs Home Workouts: What Suits You?
articles.excerpt: Gym or home? The answer depends on your personality and lifestyle. Your Twin helps you choose the environment where you'll actually stick with fitness.

articles.title: Setting Health Goals That Actually Stick
articles.excerpt: Most health goals fail at the setting stage, not the effort stage. Your Twin helps you set the kind that actually survives contact with a normal week.

articles.title: Pacing an Injury Recovery Without Losing Momentum
articles.excerpt: Rushing back from an injury and never returning are both common failure modes. Your Twin helps you find the pace in between.

articles.title: When to Get a Second Medical Opinion
articles.excerpt: Wanting a second opinion isn't distrust — it's due diligence. Your Twin helps you know when it's actually warranted.

articles.title: Taking a Mental Health Day Without the Guilt
articles.excerpt: You don't need to justify a mental health day with a diagnosis. Your Twin helps you take it before you need it, not after.

articles.title: Making Time for Preventive Care
articles.excerpt: Preventive care always loses to urgent tasks — until it doesn't. Your Twin helps you treat it as non-negotiable before it becomes urgent.

articles.title: Quitting a Habit That's Not Working For You Anymore
articles.excerpt: Willpower rarely wins against a habit loop. Your Twin helps you find what's actually driving it first.

articles.title: Setting Screen Time Boundaries That Work
articles.excerpt: Screen time limits fail when they fight the pull instead of redirecting it. Your Twin helps you build boundaries that actually hold.

articles.title: Handling the Seasonal Mood Shift
articles.excerpt: A predictable seasonal dip deserves a planned response, not a surprised one every year. Your Twin helps you prepare ahead of it.

articles.title: Fixing a Broken Sleep Schedule
articles.excerpt: Your sleep schedule didn't break overnight, and it won't fix overnight either. Your Twin helps you find the one lever that actually moves it.

articles.title: Trading Sleep for Productivity — Is It Worth It?
articles.excerpt: Cutting sleep for output feels efficient in the moment. Your Twin helps you see the real trade you're making.

articles.title: Cutting Through Supplement Hype
articles.excerpt: Most supplement decisions are made from marketing, not evidence. Your Twin helps you tell the difference before you buy.

articles.title: Should You Start Therapy?
articles.excerpt: You don't need a crisis to justify therapy. Your Twin helps you separate 'do I need this' from 'is this worth trying.'

articles.title: Personal Wellness Decisions Guided by Your Twin
articles.excerpt: Health is built on small decisions made consistently. Discover how Twin intelligence helps you navigate fitness, nutrition, mental health, and self-care with intention instead of guilt or willpower alone.

articles.title: Protecting Your Health When Work Won't Slow Down
articles.excerpt: Waiting for work to slow down before prioritizing your health means waiting forever. Your Twin helps you build boundaries that hold under pressure.

articles.title: Breaking Up: How to Know It's Time
articles.excerpt: Knowing when to end a relationship is hard. Your Twin helps you distinguish between rough patches and genuine incompatibility—so you can decide with clarity instead of panic.
